data/quiz-catalogue.summary: 40 card records consolidated from the literals in eleven components. Ids became quiz-<slug>; players -> stats.plays, maxPlayers -> stats.capacity, reward string -> stats.rewardCents, limitedTime+expiresIn -> stats.limitedTimeEndsAt (an instant anchored at the demo epoch, never a stored duration), timeLimit minutes -> settings.timeLimitSeconds, createdBy/creatorAvatar -> author, status active/draft/completed -> published/draft/archived. Derived columns (spotsLeft, almostFull) are no longer stored. Authoring-only metrics (completionRate, averageScore, revenue) live in data/quiz-analytics.ts, not in the record. Fields the schema requires and no fixture carried (summary on all 40; difficulty on the 9 featured-page records; timeLimitSeconds on the 13 records that stated none) are authored in the module and listed above only where two sources disagreed.

data/quiz-catalogue → data/quizzes (reco.summary: Two collections, one winner. d2's data/quiz-catalogue.ts (40 records) and the migration's data/quizzes.ts (42) shared 13 ids and 7 more cards under ids d2 invented; 20 ids were genuinely new. The 40 became 20: 13 lost to the identical migration record, 7 folded onto the frozen §8 id they duplicate (same title, and in six cases the same engagement numbers), and the remaining 20 moved into data/browse-quizzes.ts. Final collection: 62. d2's own conflict rulings above are unchanged and still describe its tree; this row is the reconciliation that overrides five of them, with the canonical value named per conflict. data/quiz-catalogue.ts is now a shelf/ordering view with no records of its own and holds the alias table that E10/E11 police. E1/E2 stay clean; the new E11 fails the build if two records ever share a normalised title again.
